ipp_hybrid.label: IPP hybrid (capacity payment, guarantees of origin, land, insurance)

lines.name: Capacity payment (BESS, firm capacity)
lines.note: Battery capacity in service, in kW a year. Set linked_share to the typed de-rating factor of the market (the share of nameplate that clears; empty means 1, no de-rating). The PPAs, merchant export and CfD are the energy model's locked rows, never lines here.

hint.source: GB capacity market auctions, per de-rated kW-year (T-1 2025/26 and T-4 2028/29 clearing prices)
hint.note: Per de-rated kW: apply the technology's de-rating factor through linked_share.

lines.name: Guarantees of origin
lines.note: Typed: the certified MWh a year you expect to sell. Typed, not linked: a line linked to the grid export is refused double_count (the export is priced by the energy model's locked rows).

lines.name: Land lease, wind farm
lines.note: Lease per MW of wind capacity in service per year. No sourced default: enter the price, or delete the row on owned land.

lines.name: Land lease, PV plant
lines.note: Lease per MW of PV capacity in service per year. No sourced default: enter the price, or delete the row on owned land.

lines.name: Plant capex
lines.note: Plant capex not in the energy model's asset capex (grid connection, balance of plant, installation): the base of the insurance share. Capex is priced once: do not re-enter the generators or the battery. No sourced default: enter the price and life.

lines.name: Insurance
lines.note: Share of the plant capex above per year. No sourced default for generation plant: enter the share.
